# Bundled Google Fonts licenses

All families in the curated set are licensed under the SIL
Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1), which permits embedding and redistribution.
Files are fetched at build time from the pinned `google/fonts` commit; see
`fonts.bzl`. The original OFL notices from that revision are checked in under
`licenses/<repo>.txt`, using each family's `repo` value from the pin table.
Generation includes their full copyright and license text in
`CatalogFontNotices.txt` and records each notice's source URL and SHA-256 in the
asset manifest.
